scope: Selected immutable cairn-core: the authoritative completion evaluator, the cairn.selected-work.v1 snapshot DTO and portable admission, and the workflow-obligation export consumed by kiln-adapter-cairn. The separately consumed gate contract and producer fixtures in vendor/cairn stay at their own revision. Its transitive artifact-auth and kiln-core Git dependencies resolve to the verified vendor/artifact and vendor/cairn-kiln-core imports through root manifest patches.
nonclaims: The evaluator checks supplied trusted-execution evidence; importing it does not execute checks, create evidence, grant authority, publish source, or establish release eligibility.
manifest_normalization: Absent workspace members are pruned from the retained root manifest so Cargo resolves only selected packages.
formatter_scope: Tree-local rustfmt.toml disables host formatting of immutable producer source.
